hooks.name: Security review of crypto changes
hooks.description: Reminds the agent of the key-custody rules whenever the letter crypto changes.

action.prompt: You just edited the letter crypto. Re-check: AES-GCM 256 only, a fresh random 96-bit IV per encryption, the full letter key never leaves the browser, key halves are never logged, and tests/unit/crypto.test.ts still covers round-trip, tamper and wrong-half cases.
